title: Point counts and zeta function
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], where $q=p^a$ and $k_0=\Fq$, and for every integer $n\geq1$ let $\mathbf F_{q^n}\subset k$ be the subfield with $q^n$ elements; let $Y_0$ be a finite-type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] $k_0$-scheme. Fix
an indeterminate $T$. For every integer $n\geq1$, put

$$
 Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})=\operatorname{Hom}_{k_0}
 (\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf F_{q^n},Y_0),
 \qquad
 N_n(Y_0)=\#Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n}),
$$

the set of $\mathbf F_{q^n}$-valued points of $Y_0$ over $k_0$ and its number of elements [def-weil-field-valued-points], which is finite [lem-weil-point-counts-finite].

Write $|Y_0|$ for the set of closed points of $Y_0$ [def-weil-closed-points]. For a closed point
$x\in|Y_0|$, let $\kappa(x)$ be its residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and set
$\deg(x)=[\kappa(x):\Fq]$, its degree over $k_0$ [def-weil-closed-point-degree]. For every integer $r\geq1$, put

$$
 c_r=\#\{x\in|Y_0|:\deg(x)=r\},
$$

the number of closed points of degree $r$, which is finite [lem-weil-point-counts-finite].

Define the Hasse--Weil zeta series by

$$
 Z(Y_0,T)=
 \exp\left(\sum_{n\geq1}N_n(Y_0)\frac{T^n}{n}\right)
 \in1+T\mathbf Q[[T]].
$$

Here $\mathbf Q[[T]]$ is the ring of formal power series in $T$ with rational coefficients [def-weil-formal-power-series], and the exponential is the formal power-series exponential [def-weil-power-series-exponential] of the series $\sum_{n\geq1}N_n(Y_0)T^n/n\in T\mathbf Q[[T]]$, so that $Z(Y_0,T)$ has constant coefficient $1$.

mathlib_searches.results: only the arithmetic-function zeta (Mathlib/NumberTheory/ArithmeticFunction/Zeta.lean), L-series and cyclotomic files; nothing in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry: no zeta series of a scheme over a finite field
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match; every notion it is built from is a Mathlib leaf except the finiteness lemma (see stmt_deps)

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the master blueprint node (verbatim) and the slopmaster2 LaTeX (sketch/01_final_weil_conjectures.tex lines 2940–2962, which has the same definition without the c_r clause and without the Frobenius clause). Kept every defined object (Y_0(F_{q^n}), N_n, |Y_0|, κ(x), deg(x), c_r, Z(Y_0,T)) and added the bracketed names of the notions each is built from: the finite-field datum and F_{q^n} (def-weil-finite-field-fiber), finite type (def-weil-finite-type-morphism, in place of the grab-bag def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties), field-valued points and their number (new leaf def-weil-field-valued-points, over-category homs + Nat.card), closed points (new leaf def-weil-closed-points, Mathlib closedPoints), residue field (new leaf def-weil-residue-field, Scheme.residueField), the degree of a closed point (new leaf def-weil-closed-point-degree, Scheme.Hom.residueDegree), formal power series (existing leaf def-weil-formal-power-series), the formal exponential (new leaf def-weil-power-series-exponential, PowerSeries.exp ∘ PowerSeries.subst), and the finiteness that the symbols # presuppose (new statement lem-weil-point-counts-finite, unsplit, Lean closed on both branches). Removed def-weil-frobenius-detailed from stmt_deps and from the statement: the clause 'use geometric Frobenius' is a convention for later nodes that none of the defined objects uses, and the slopmaster2 text of the definition has no such clause. Recorded that the claim Z ∈ 1 + TQ[[T]] is the constant-coefficient clause of the exponential node. Mathlib searched for the zeta series itself: none. Left lean, lean_audit, blueprint_* and import_flags untouched; the Lean findings (pointCount and zetaSeries live in Comparator/Weil/Definitions.lean, module Weil.Definitions, which the audit does not scan) are in the delivery report.
